market_summary: During early London trading, markets are predominantly consolidating inside session Value Areas with sub-2.0 RVOL. Metals and US100 are pressing against key support zones near session lows and VALs below their respective VWAPs, but lack high-volume breakdown confirmation. GBPUSD is testing session highs against bearish delta divergence, and BTCUSD is tightly anchored to fair-value POC. All five assets warrant a disciplined HOLD pending clearer directional catalyst or structural resolution.
